gloss: to twist; to wrench; to wring

definitions.explanation: To forcefully twist or wring something by rotating.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}をよじって{逃|に}げようとした。
examples.english: I tried to escape by twisting my body.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}いすぎてお{腹|なか}をよじった。
examples.english: I laughed so hard my stomach hurt (I twisted my belly from laughing).

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}をよじられて{痛|いた}かった。
examples.english: My arm was twisted and it hurt.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{身|み}をよじる - to twist one's body (often from pain, tickling, or trying to escape)
・{腹|はら}/お{腹|なか}をよじる - to twist one's belly (from laughing hard)
・{腕|うで}をよじる - to twist someone's arm

CONJUGATION NOTE:
Godan verb conjugating with る. Dictionary form: よじる

RELATED:
・{捻|ひね}る - to twist, turn (more general)
・{絞|しぼ}る - to wring, squeeze
・よじ{登|のぼ}る - to climb (by twisting one's body)
